name: TEBIN Classic
description: Faithful reproduction of the 2017 TEBIN print brand book: Pantone red + grey, Roboto / Arial, corporate-print identity.

source.url: TEBIN Branding Principles & Style Guide (2017, Rev. A)

author: TEBIN

omitted.reason: Document theme: table rules come from Word's own table styles, and the 2017 brand book names no hairline colour.

The brand book's grey #898D8D is 3.36:1 on white — below the 4.5:1 floor for small text. It is a colour to paint with, not one to read; the book prices no darker grey, so this theme has no secondary text colour.
A printed page has no error, warning or success state.
No canonical button exists across the TEBIN apps; codifying one would invent a house style rather than record one.
